title: The Lost Sock
learning_objectives: Follow a search through several places
Use position words: under, behind, inside
parent_prompts: Let the child read alone. After: where did Nia look? Where was the sock in the end, and why was it there?

pages.text: Nia has one blue sock. Where is the other one?
pages.illustration_brief: Nia (purple overalls) holding up a single blue sock, puzzled.
pages.audio_script: Nia has one blue sock. Where is the other one?
pages.image_alt: Nia holding up a single blue sock, puzzled.

pages.text: Nia looks under the bed. A shoe. A book. No sock.
pages.illustration_brief: Nia lying flat peering under a bed; a shoe and a book visible underneath.
pages.audio_script: Nia looks under the bed. A shoe. A book. No sock.

vocabulary.example: The cat hides under the table.

pages.image_alt: Nia peering under a bed; a shoe and a book underneath.

pages.text: Nia looks behind the door. A coat. A bag. No sock.
pages.illustration_brief: Nia swinging a door open; a coat and a bag on hooks behind it.
pages.audio_script: Nia looks behind the door. A coat. A bag. No sock.

vocabulary.example: The ball rolled behind the sofa.

pages.image_alt: Nia swinging a door open; a coat and a bag on hooks behind it.

pages.text: Nia looks inside the basket. Shirts. Pants. No sock.
pages.illustration_brief: Nia digging through a laundry basket full of clothes.
pages.audio_script: Nia looks inside the basket. Shirts. Pants. No sock.

vocabulary.example: The toy is inside the box.

pages.image_alt: Nia digging through a laundry basket full of clothes.

pages.text: Then Nia hears a purr. She looks in the cat's bed.
pages.illustration_brief: A round cat bed in a corner; Nia tiptoeing toward it, hand to ear.
pages.audio_script: Then Nia hears a purr. She looks in the cat's bed.
pages.image_alt: A round cat bed in a corner; Nia tiptoeing toward it.

pages.text: The cat is asleep. On the blue sock! It is warm and soft. "You can keep it," says Nia.
pages.illustration_brief: A grey cat curled asleep on a blue sock; Nia smiling.
pages.audio_script: The cat is asleep. On the blue sock! It is warm and soft. You can keep it, says Nia.
pages.image_alt: A grey cat curled asleep on a blue sock; Nia smiling.

quiz.prompt: What does Nia find under the bed?
quiz.explanation: Page 2 says: A shoe. A book. No sock.

quiz.prompt: How does Nia know where to look last?
quiz.explanation: Page 5: Then Nia hears a purr. She looks in the cat's bed.
First under the bed (page 2), then behind the door (page 3), then inside the basket (page 4).

quiz.prompt: Why does Nia let the cat keep the sock?

options.text: The cat likes it because it is warm and soft

quiz.explanation: Page 6 says the sock is warm and soft and the cat is asleep on it, so Nia lets the cat keep it.

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up the three places Nia looked and where the sock really was.
quiz.rubric: not yet: names one place; with support: two places with prompting; independent: under the bed, behind the door, inside the basket, then on the cat's bed
quiz.explanation: Using the position words in order shows both sequence and vocabulary.

activities.prompt: Match the word to its meaning.

off_screen_prompt: Hide a sock. Give someone three clues using under, behind or inside.
